customManagers.description: The read-only Drydock core the Objective-C artifact reader compiles (components/objc-reader-drydock/version). scripts/objc-compat-build.sh fetches GitHub's tarball of exactly DIGEST through fetch_pinned_source.sh and verifies it against ARCHIVE_SHA256, which this manager does not move: a bump fails closed until ARCHIVE_SHA256 is rewritten after checking with git that the tarball holds exactly the commit's tree. A bump must pass tests/objc-reader-test.sh and tests/objc-binding-test.sh.
The cmake product shipyard's launchers run and its pkg requires (components/cmake/version). install@v1 installs this release, verified against its SHA256SUMS; a bump releases shipyard on green.

The clang22 that builds shipyard's Sparkle updater on every host (components/clang22/version). scripts/fetch_clang22.sh verifies its Linux archive against components/clang22/linux-sha256 and its pkgs against the release's SHA256SUMS.

The Xcode-project source exporter MavericksHostTools.cmake builds for the host (components/mulle-xcode-to-cmake/version): REF is the upstream branch tracked, DIGEST its pinned commit, TARBALL_SHA256 the digest of GitHub's tarball of that commit, which fetch_pinned_source.sh verifies.
The ed25519-sign that signs every family release (scripts/ed25519.pin). sign_and_appcast.sh verifies the pkg against the release's SHA256SUMS.
The Recaulk whose librecaulk.a defines the C++ runtime machinery the conformance rule allows (scripts/recaulk.pin). cxxabi-allowlist.sh verifies the pkg against the release's SHA256SUMS.
The stevedore packager (scripts/stevedore.pin). fetch_stevedore.sh verifies the asset against the release's SHA256SUMS.
The Renovate release that validates default.json in CI (scripts/renovate.pin, run by linux-host.yml). Pinned so the check does not move without a commit.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves components/clang22/version and components/objc-reference-clang/version but cannot write the Linux archive's digest beside either, so the Linux job fails on the bump until the linux-sha256 beside the moved version names the new release's archive.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, replace the linux-sha256 beside each moved version (components/clang22, components/objc-reference-clang) with the `clang22-<version>-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` line of the new release's SHA256SUMS: `gh release download <version> -R Mavergreen/clang-22 -p SHA256SUMS -O - | grep linux-x86_64.tar.gz > components/<dir>/linux-sha256`. An objc-reference-clang bump must also pass tests/objc-source-inventory-host-test.sh on Linux and a Mac.

packageRules.description: Renovate moves DIGEST in components/mulle-xcode-to-cmake/version but cannot write TARBALL_SHA256 beside it, so the host-tool build refuses the bump until that digest names GitHub's tarball of the new commit, checked against the commit's tree.
prBodyNotes: Before this can merge, set TARBALL_SHA256 in components/mulle-xcode-to-cmake/version to the SHA-256 of `https://codeload.github.com/mulle-nat/mulle-xcode-to-cmake/tar.gz/<new DIGEST>`, after checking that the tarball's files are that commit's tree (`git archive` of the commit compared with the extracted tarball).

packageRules.description: The renovate pin moves at most monthly: each bump costs macOS runner time in shipyard's CI and then its release, and the validator gains nothing from tracking Renovate's every release.
schedule: on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: linux-host.yml's setup-node runs Renovate's own config validator, whose package requires node ^24.11.0, so node stays on 24 until a renovate pin needs another major.
